step_name: Operational Maintenance, Automated Discovery Reconciliation, and 'No Ticket No Touch' Enforcement

subprocess_flow.description: ServiceNow ITOM Discovery initiates automated scheduled scans across all data centre management IP subnets, out-of-band management fabrics (iLO/iDRAC), and core network switches. The discovery probe collector queries hardware configurations, active components, MAC addresses, and attached interfaces to compile an updated physical snapshot.
inputs: Daily ServiceNow ITOM Discovery and Event Management feeds
Target Data Centre Subnet Range Catalog
dependencies: Mandatory Operational Approval Gate and Baseline Production Activation
success_criteria: 100% of data centre network segments and management fabrics successfully scanned with zero probe timeouts
subprocess_flow.purpose: Capture real-time physical and logical configurations of all active hardware infrastructure across production environments.
subprocess_flow.scope: All operational server blades, rack units, network fabrics, and storage appliances within primary and backup data halls.
triggers: Scheduled daily automated ServiceNow ITOM Discovery cycle
Ad-hoc discovery trigger following emergency maintenance
end_conditions: Raw discovery payload generated and ingested into the ServiceNow Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE)

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Scan failures or credential expiration leading to visibility blind spots across critical subnets.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated MID server health alerts and daily credential heartbeat monitors alerting IT Operations.

change_management.change_request_process: Alterations to discovery schedules or MID server configurations require a Standard Change Request.
change_management.versioning_rules: Discovery schedules and MID server IP ranges are version-tracked in ServiceNow system configuration records.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Correlate Discovered Deltas Against Approved Changes
subprocess_flow.description: The ServiceNow Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) and automated reconciliation scripts compare discovered attribute deltas against authorized CMDB Configuration Baselines. The engine simultaneously queries active ServiceNow Change Requests and Change Tasks to determine whether any detected hardware divergence corresponds to an approved Change Request currently in state 'Work in Progress'.
inputs: Active ServiceNow Change Request and Task schedules
success_criteria: 100% of discovered configuration deltas evaluated against active change records within 10 minutes of scan completion
subprocess_flow.purpose: Enforce the 'No Ticket, No Touch' governance rule by systematically validating whether detected physical changes have prior CAB authorization.
subprocess_flow.scope: All attribute deltas including CPU, memory modules, disk drives, NIC MAC addresses, switch port bindings, and new network endpoints.
triggers: Ingestion of fresh ITOM Discovery payload into ServiceNow IRE
end_conditions: Every identified attribute divergence is mapped to an approved Change Task or categorized as an unauthorized baseline breach

step_risks_and_controls.risk: False-positive correlation caused by timing discrepancies between change status updates and scan runs.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated 5-minute synchronization grace period cross-referencing change implementation schedules before raising violations.

change_management.change_request_process: Modifications to baseline reconciliation logic or correlation criteria must be approved by CAB and CCB.
change_management.versioning_rules: IRE reconciliation rules and correlation filters are version-controlled under ServiceNow update sets.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Enforce Automated CI Lockdown and Network Containment
subprocess_flow.description: When an unapproved configuration divergence or unmapped hardware device is confirmed, ServiceNow automated policy actions immediately lock the affected Configuration Item record to prevent further updates or status manipulation. If an unrecognized physical host or rogue MAC address is identified, the system signals the network access control fabric to execute automated port isolation or VLAN quarantine within 15 minutes.
dependencies: Correlate Discovered Deltas Against Approved Changes
success_criteria: 100% of unauthorized hardware CIs locked and untracked endpoints isolated from live trading subnets within 15 minutes
subprocess_flow.purpose: Prevent configuration tampering, contain potential cyber or physical intrusions, and preserve forensic state upon detection of unauthorized alterations.
subprocess_flow.scope: All hardware assets diverging without an approved change, and any undocumented network-connected compute hardware.
triggers: Detection of unauthorized configuration divergence by the discovery reconciliation engine
end_conditions: Target CI attribute editing locked in CMDB and network port isolation confirmed via switch telemetry

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Accidental network containment of legitimate trading services due to misidentified drift.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Dual-validation check on Critical Economic Functions preventing port shutdown on redundant trading nodes without human engineer validation.

governance_requirements: FCA PS21/3 Important Business Service Protection

change_management.change_request_process: Unlocking a locked CI record requires an approved Change Request or Major Incident remediation task.
change_management.versioning_rules: Lockdown timestamps and security flags are recorded immutably in the ServiceNow CI audit history.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Generate Unauthorized Change Incident and Regulatory Alert
subprocess_flow.description: ServiceNow automatically instantiates a high-severity Incident: Sev-1 if the asset underpins a Critical Economic Function (CEF) or Important Business Service (IBS), or Sev-2 for supporting tiers. The incident record automatically captures attribute-level divergence,Discovery timestamps, and affected upstream business services. The system dispatches immediate automated alerts to Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, and the Change Advisory Board, while logging a regulatory compliance event for FCA PS21/3.
outputs: FCA PS21/3 Regulatory Compliance Telemetry Event
dependencies: Enforce Automated CI Lockdown and Network Containment
success_criteria: Automated Sev-1/Sev-2 incident created and routed to on-call responders within 15 minutes of drift identification
subprocess_flow.purpose: Mobilize immediate incident response, document governance breaches, and fulfill regulatory obligations for operational resilience reporting.
subprocess_flow.scope: All unauthorized hardware modifications, blade swaps, memory alterations, and rogue device introductions.
triggers: Completion of CI lockdown following confirmed unauthorized drift
end_conditions: Incident assigned to Infrastructure Engineering on-call engineer and acknowledged by CAB and InfoSec

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incident misclassification leading to delayed incident response on Important Business Services.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated severity calculation driven directly by CMDB Important Business Service tier mapping.

change_management.change_request_process: Any post-incident configuration acceptance requires formal Emergency Change Request sign-off by CAB.
change_management.versioning_rules: All incident metadata and CI field deltas are written to ServiceNow sys_audit and cmdb_activity.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Triage, Investigate, and Remediate Configuration Drift
subprocess_flow.description: Infrastructure Engineering and Information Security engineers investigate the root cause of the unauthorized physical or logical change. Technicians either physically revert the unauthorized alteration (restoring the hardware to its authorized CMDB baseline) or, if the change was a valid emergency intervention that bypassed standard ticketing, submit an Emergency Change Request (CHG) for retrospective CAB review and technical baseline re-certification.
outputs: Unauthorized Change Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Document
subprocess_flow.estimated_duration: 2 to 4 hours depending on incident severity and tier
dependencies: Generate Unauthorized Change Incident and Regulatory Alert
success_criteria: 100% of unauthorized drifts resolved via baseline restoration or retrospective CAB ratification within SLA targets
subprocess_flow.purpose: Eliminate unauthorized alterations, re-establish baseline integrity, and ensure complete accountability for physical interventions.
subprocess_flow.scope: Target physical hosts, network ports, SAN attachments, and affected data centre hardware racks.
triggers: Assignment of Sev-1/Sev-2 Unauthorized Change Incident
end_conditions: Hardware matches authorized CMDB baseline, CI lock is released, and incident is transitioned to Resolved

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Remediation attempt inadvertently disrupts live financial transactions on clustered hosts.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Strict adherence to dual-engineer verification and safe failover procedures prior to physical component reversal.

change_management.change_request_process: Retrospective change approval requires formal Emergency CAB sign-off with documented justification.
change_management.versioning_rules: Configuration updates following CAB ratification establish a new stamped baseline version.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Publish CMDB Health Scorecards and Regulatory Audit Ledger
subprocess_flow.description: The Configuration Management team executes automated data integrity calculations across the CMDB, evaluating Correctness (IRE duplicate and drift-free accuracy), Completeness, and Compliance against the >99.5% accuracy target. Daily reconciliation reports and audit-ready CI lifecycle telemetry logs are archived for internal risk oversight and external FCA/PRA regulatory audits.
inputs: Daily ServiceNow ITOM Discovery and Event Management feeds
outputs: Continuous Daily CMDB Discovery Reconciliation Reports
Audit-ready CI Lifecycle Event History and Telemetry Logs
Audit Trail of CI attribute changes
dependencies: Triage, Investigate, and Remediate Configuration Drift
success_criteria: CMDB hardware data correctness maintained above 99.5% and daily audit ledgers compiled with 100% compliance
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide verifiable data integrity scorecards to senior leadership and regulatory authorities attesting to continuous operational resilience.
subprocess_flow.scope: All hardware assets, CIs, and Important Business Service dependencies across enterprise data centres.
triggers: Executive or regulatory audit data submission request
end_conditions: CMDB Health Dashboard updated, scorecard published, and compliance evidence archived in the regulatory register

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Failure to meet the >99.5% correctness threshold exposing the bank to regulatory sanctions under FCA PS21/3.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Daily automated escalations to the Head of Operational Resilience and CCB whenever score drops below 99.5%.

governance_requirements: FCA SYSC 15.9 Operational Risk and Resilience Systems & Controls

change_management.change_request_process: Changes to CMDB scorecard weighting and compliance algorithms require approval from the Configuration Control Board.
change_management.versioning_rules: Scorecard historical snapshots are immutably archived with cryptographic checksums.
